facts.fact: 家庭餐厅猫脸机器人避过幼童的番茄酱薯条、微笑驶过——服务自动化已到卖萌级别
facts.anchor: smiled toward the girl, moved to avoid coming into contact with the messy fry

facts.fact: Mikoshiba 的 host club 男友 Inui（橡子眼、卷刘海）连大学论文都靠 AI 应用写
facts.anchor: I use an AI app for all the papers I’m assigned at school

facts.fact: 窗外车流同速同距如传送带——她自嘲自己也像被传送带载着，每天自动驾驶般上班
facts.anchor: maybe I was being carried on a conveyor belt, too

facts.fact: 灾难结果：Strada 幸无骨折但韧带重伤，经与赛事兽医商议在附近马厩休养
facts.anchor: he had hurt his ligaments pretty badly

facts.fact: 马具全沾泥，与她手袋同皮料的马鞍上一道深长裂口——触到伤痕耳边回到马的哀鸣，瘫在沙发不能动
facts.anchor: there was a deep gash in the saddle that was made of the same leather as my bag

facts.fact: Inui 自白：我怕沉默——host club 的前辈总吼我要填满每一段沉默
facts.anchor: The guys who’ve been working at the host club longer than me are always yelling

facts.fact: Mikoshiba 马论：马最好——要花很多钱，但你们能真正互相理解；她求认同，Yuko 点头：Strada 是唯一懂她的
facts.anchor: you can truly understand them, and they you

facts.fact: Mikoshiba 渴望词语：Inui 比马蠢却话多——空话也好，他给我很多词
facts.anchor: No matter how empty those words are, he gives a lot of them to me

facts.fact: 幻觉：Strada 立在饮料吧前（机器人穿梭处）湿润的眼睛看她——她在心里点了一杯拿铁
facts.anchor: I felt a black presence behind Inui and glanced over his shoulder to find a horse there

facts.fact: 同居幻想：夜里他在窗边望月、清晨小桌共餐，她为他剥苹果吃同样的东西；骑着他去哪儿都行——念头刚起他已迈步
facts.anchor: Just a moment before I had the thought, Strada would start walking
